integration.strategy: Build selected Python distributions from exact source commit c93d5de56b088ec43a2e0acf0a9e6e74f0fd58da. This is selected-distribution evidence only and is not release approval.

change_scope.interpretation: The selected package is frozen to the exact source SHA. Changes since the prior package-qualified candidate require fresh package qualification; this contract performs no scientific solve and does not render docs.

candidate_execution_profile.source_materialization: Only selected regular Git blobs from the exact frozen source_sha; no worktree source bytes.
candidate_execution_profile.build_command: Set SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH to the frozen source commit timestamp and TEMP/TMP to a newly created task-specific directory on E:; run scripts/verify_public_package.py from a clean contract checkout using the fingerprinted isolated build environment and a new external output directory.

build_environment.provisioning: Dedicated isolated virtual environment; system-site-packages disabled; pip check passed; environment executable and distribution file-tree fingerprints reverified before contract freeze.
build_environment.temporary_storage: Immediately before execution, create new task-specific TEMP/TMP and artifact output directories on E:, both outside the source checkout; record free space and absolute paths only in the private execution log. No stale free-space measurement is carried forward.

artifacts_expected.raw_sha256: computed and recorded by the execution manifest; not predeclared

candidate_execution_profile.reproducibility: One candidate build only; no A/B build or normalized reproducibility claim.
archive_checks: selected byte equality against source Git blobs
strict seven-rule scan of archive payloads
no undeclared sdist/wheel payloads except declared generated metadata
regular files and safe portable paths only
installed_probes: install exact local wheel with --no-deps --no-index in the runner-created environment
verify installed Python source hashes and import origins
verify-all refusal inside and outside checkout without subprocess launch
candidate_execution_profile.supplementary_metadata_check: Run twine check against the exact wheel and raw sdist after the frozen runner; record argv, tool version, exit status and output hashes.
candidate_execution_profile.dependency_isolation: The build-tool environment is isolated and pip check clean. The verifier-created installed-probe venv uses --system-site-packages by design; its dependency context is not hermetic and will be reported separately.

limitations: One selected wheel and sdist build for this exact source SHA; strict package payload scan and byte reconciliation; installed package/source probe; three CLI version checks; help and verify-all refusal. No publication.
No FEM, modal qualification, full CI, cross-platform test, A/B or normalized reproducibility claim.
The runner-created installed probe environment uses --system-site-packages and is not hermetic. The isolated build-tools environment is separately fingerprinted and pip-check clean.
The scan is limited to selected package sources/artifacts. It does not clear repository history, GitHub automatic source archives, Actions logs/artifacts, Pages, or the whole-repository G03 result.
Legal review remains NOT_ACQUIRED; scientific modal maturity remains EXPERIMENTAL; RELEASE remains BLOCKED. No tag, merge, upload, deployment or publication.
owner_authorization: Owner mandate dated 2026-11-06 authorizes a prospective local FROZEN_CANDIDATE_BUILD contract and selected wheel/sdist qualification bound to this exact source commit. No FEM, CI, tag, push, merge, upload, deployment or publication is authorized.
supersession_reason: Prospective source is c93d5de56b088ec43a2e0acf0a9e6e74f0fd58da, after local release-documentation corrections. Earlier package identities remain bound to their own source SHA and are not reused.

environment_tool_bindings.distribution_fingerprint_method: For each build distribution, SHA-256 over sorted UTF-8 lines relative-posix-path<TAB>file-SHA256 with LF separators; separately SHA-256 of raw dist-info/RECORD bytes.
